title: Short Iceland · Reykjavík + South Coast — June 2027

packing: Cold-rain kit: waterproof shells and pants, warm mid-layers, hats and gloves.
Warm-water kit: swimsuits and compact towels for pools and lagoons.
Sleep: blackout masks for bright June nights.
Driving: offline maps, a PIN-enabled card and a strict wind-door habit.

itinerary.labelHtml:
Day by Day

Seven nights from Reykjavík to the South Coast

Each day includes the drive, weather reality, family food choices and expected activity costs.

days.heading: PIT → KEF overnight
days.feel: One nonstop overnight flight; no connection or self-transfer.
days.note: Eat before boarding and treat this as transportation, not an activity day.

days.heading: Soft landing in Reykjavík
days.feel: Pick up one automatic car, check in for two nights, walk the compact center, then reset in a warm local pool.
days.note: Keep the first day low-stakes; groceries and an early night protect the rest of the week.

spots.climate: Expect roughly 45–57°F, wind and spray. Strokkur usually erupts every few minutes; Gullfoss viewpoints are short walks but wet. Waterproof shells matter more than umbrellas.
spots.saveHtml: Save Pack lunch and treat the landscapes as the activity; do not add every paid crater and greenhouse stop.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Reserve Friðheimar tomato greenhouse for soup, pasta and a memorable lunch.

spots.climate: Near-freezing feel, wind and glare. Use warm layers, waterproofs, gloves and sturdy boots. Never step onto the glacier without a certified guide.
spots.saveHtml: Save Walk only to the free glacier-tongue viewpoint if the tour price or the child fit is wrong.

spots.cost: No admission; Reynisfjara currently uses paid parking. Treat the beach as a brief viewpoint, not a play stop, and obey the live warning lights.
spots.climate: Ocean water around 50°F and dangerous sneaker waves. This is not a swim. Stay well back on dry sand, face the sea, and leave immediately if the warning system escalates.
spots.saveHtml: Save Keep it short and pair it with the paid glacier tour; the coastal views themselves are free.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge None needed—spend on a warm meal in Vík after the glacier.
spots.restoHtml:

spots.altboxHtml:

  • Dyrhólaey upper viewpoint if road and nesting restrictions allow.
  • Skip entirely when warning lights or wind are unfavorable.

days.heading: Weather buffer + local recovery
days.feel: A deliberately unscheduled half-day absorbs whatever Iceland moved earlier; use Hella pool or Lava Centre after.
days.note: This buffer is what makes a seven-night Iceland plan feel easy instead of frantic.

days.heading: Reykjanes finale near the airport
days.feel: Move west once, explore only where official conditions are normal, and sleep close to KEF.
days.note: The premium lagoon is optional; the budget version is a free coast loop and local pool.

spots.cost: Gunnuhver, Bridge Between Continents and coastal viewpoints are free. Blue Lagoon pricing is dynamic and can exceed $100 per person; it is deliberately optional, not baked into the low budget.
spots.climate: Windy and changeable. Reykjanes access and air quality can change quickly with volcanic activity. Check SafeTravel and the Icelandic Met Office before leaving the main road.
spots.saveHtml: Save Do the free peninsula loop, eat in Keflavík and use a local pool instead of Blue Lagoon.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Book a refundable Blue Lagoon slot only if operations and air quality are normal 48 hours before arrival.

preDepartureTodos.labelHtml:
Before You Go

What to reserve, and when

Book the nonstop first, hold family rooms next and keep the weather-sensitive extras flexible.

blocks.title: Quote the actual week
items: Price PIT–KEF Jun 13–21 for all four travelers with selected seats and required bags.
Buy only if the exact nonstop pattern works and the family total stays under $3,600.
Hold refundable kitchen lodging in Reykjavík, Hella/Hvolsvöllur and Keflavík.

blocks.title: Protect the simple route
items: Reserve one automatic rental at KEF with transparent gravel and sand/ash terms.
Book the age-8 glacier tour and confirm the shoe-size rule in writing.
Check passport validity and the live ETIAS launch status.

blocks.title: Add only the timed extras
items: Choose a refundable whale boat only if the family wants it.
Treat Blue Lagoon as optional and refundable, never a route dependency.

blocks.title: Operational checks
items: Download SafeTravel, road and weather resources plus offline maps.
Recheck Reykjanes access, glacier weather and Reynisfjara warning practice.
Pack waterproof layers, eye masks, swimsuits, quick-dry towels and picnic gear.

preDepartureTodos.callout: Booking order matters: exact nonstop → refundable beds → car → glacier → optional extras.
